title: 娜美·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 橙色头发衬出绿松石色鳞尾，金色法杖顶端带贝壳装饰。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Nami is an adult merfolk woman with pale sea-green skin, orange hair, fin-shaped ears, a turquoise scaled tail, and a long gold shell-topped staff. Her torso is completely covered by a structured blue ceremonial tunic with pearl and gold trim; preserve the continuous fish-tail anatomy.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: sea green, turquoise, pale gold, white surf, navy; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
